During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] worked as a '''businessman'''. While on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[3643 BBY]], he needed to travel to the [[Old Galactic Market]] and argued with a [[Unidentified shuttle operator|shuttle operator]] over a travel advisory for that area.

==Biography==
[[File:TwiLekHandThrust.png|thumb|right|250px|The Twi'lek speaks with the shuttle operator.]]
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}} The three aforementioned classes all visit [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during their respective Prologues. As this is the first [[Time/Legends|time]] they can witness the conversation between the businessman and the [[Unidentified shuttle operator|shuttle operator]], it can be inferred the conversation takes place during their Prologues and therefore in 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> the businessman was on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and attempted to travel to the [[Old Galactic Market]] from the [[Air taxi/Legends|taxi]] pad in the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]]. A travel advisory was in effect for that area,<ref name="TOR" /> which was at that [[Time/Legends|time]] the site of an [[Merchants' Guild Crisis|armed revolt]] by the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]].<ref name="SWTORCiGC">{{TORcite|type=general|Crisis in Galactic City|Coruscant}}</ref> The Twi'lek began arguing with a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] [[Unidentified shuttle operator|operator]], insisting that he needed to get to the Old Galactic Market. The operator replied that he did not make the rules, being required to follow the advisory. The Twi'lek businessman informed the operator that he had a [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]] to protect himself and demanded to know if they were leaving. The operator then replied that the businessman had to sign a waiver first.<ref name="TOR" />

==Personality and traits==
The businessman had [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and green skin, and was willing to ignore the travel advisory for the Galactic Market.<ref name="TOR" />

==Equipment==
The Twi'lek wore a green, brown, and white [[Clothing/Legends|outfit]] with a black [[Belt/Legends|belt]] and green [[Boot/Legends|boots]] with a black pattern on them. He carried a stun [[Baton/Legends|baton]] for protection.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Twi'lek businessman first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] by [[BioWare]]. His NPC nameplate identifies him as "Coruscant Businessman."<ref name="TOR" />
